utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve been telling folks about the repair drive, Leo—people are planning to bring tools and pitch in, so it should get a decent turnout.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—right now we still need a couple of hammers and some work gloves for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Leo—I’ll keep repeating that we still need a couple of hammers and some work gloves for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, Noah, sorry, I’m mixing it up again; can you remind me what we’ve got first on the repair list and when we’re meeting tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—yeah, tomorrow morning. I’m still catching up a bit, but we’re meeting then for the repair drive, and Vik’s been telling folks to bring tools and pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Noah; I’ll bring my basic tools, and once someone reminds me what’s first on the list, I can be there tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in this afternoon at the community center lot—pretty sure we’re starting with the porch steps, and the hall roof’s the other main fix.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll be there this afternoon at the community center lot, and I can start with the porch steps before we move to the hall roof.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—see you there this afternoon, and we’ll start on the porch steps unless they tell us the entrance setup changed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules, let’s hold off on final numbers until Mara confirms the list, but can you tell me what’s already tentatively covered so we don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: So far it sounds like some help is lined up in general, but we still don’t have Mara’s confirmation on the house list or a definite lead for bike and small appliance fixes yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—let’s not lock anything in yet, then; once Mara confirms the house list, can you also check who can definitely take bike and small appliance fixes?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, Rey—sounds like it’s shaping up, but I still haven’t heard a firm date or start time yet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’ve heard this afternoon at the community center parking lot, but I want to confirm the exact entrance and timing with Cleo before we spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’ve been hearing—sounds close, but not settled yet. Let me know once Cleo confirms the entrance and start time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, I’m running a little late, but I can still swing by soon for the repair drive—do you know what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still have it at the community center parking lot, but I want the exact entrance confirmed first; for supplies, we’re still short a couple of hammers and some work gloves for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal—that helps; I’m still coming by late, and I’ll ask around about the entrance while I see if I can bring a hammer and some gloves.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still watching for zip ties and flashlights, Eli—if you hear who can cover those, I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Cleo — keep those on the list for now, and once we confirm the exact spot and start time at the community center, I’ll check who can cover the zip ties and flashlights.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—I’ll keep zip ties and flashlights marked as open until you confirm who’s covering them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m still set for early setup next Saturday—I’ll bring the drill, ladders, and extension cord.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus—that helps a lot. I’ve got you down for early setup next Saturday with the drill, ladders, and extension cord at the community center lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect—I’ll see you there early with the drill, ladders, and extension cord.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I’ll bring the basics next Saturday and keep an eye out for your message tonight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — one quick update: it’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the final list tonight if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Okay, Sunday at the community center works—I’ll still bring the basics and watch for your message tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, what time can you get there, and what can you bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can get there around 9, and I can bring labels and clipboards, but I want Rosa’s confirmed drop-off spot first so we don’t send people in circles.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay—9 works. Can you text Rosa now for the confirmed drop-off spot, and if that’s set, will labels and clipboards cover check-in?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you’re right, Kira—I’m hearing plenty of folks are ready to help, but I’m still trying to pin down who’s organizing and exactly what they need before I send anyone over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good—can you confirm whether Mara and Dev are definitely organizing it, and who’s already committed tools or time before we send people over?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, from what I’ve heard, Mara’s definitely involved and I think Dev is too, but I’d still like to confirm that before I start sending folks over—so far people are mostly just saying they can bring tools, spare parts, and a bit of time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Faye — if 3:30 after pickup still works and we keep it quick, that should work on my end, so just keep me posted while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, 3:30 still works for me after pickup, and I’ll send you a quick note before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — thanks, Faye, just send me that quick note and I’ll keep an eye out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — quick update: it’s now Sunday at the community center, and we’ll still start at 9 with the fence and benches first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—Sunday at the community center at 9, and I’ll start with the fence and benches.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Bo—that’s a big help. Uli’s bringing some extra tools too, so you should be all set when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: So far it’s next Saturday at the community center, and I’m bringing the screws and drill; I’m just still waiting to confirm who can cover the bike and small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—I’ll check with Cleo for the current repair list and see who can cover bikes and small appliances, and I’ll keep the setup simple with one drop-off table and one person logging things.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds perfect, Rey—thanks for checking with Cleo and keeping the setup simple. Let me know as soon as you hear who can cover bikes and small appliances so I can lock the plan in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning still needs a couple of hammers and work gloves—can you help cover either of those?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks for checking—I’m still out running errands, but you’re already down for a hammer and work gloves, and we still need that extra ladder.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I’ll bring the hammer and work gloves Saturday morning. Can you see if anyone can cover the extra ladder?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Jules, I’m in, but let’s confirm the exact spot at the community center first and make a simple list of repairs before we start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good—I’ll help pin down the exact spot at the community center and keep folks updated, and we can keep the repair list simple to start.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Jules—that’s exactly what I needed; once we confirm the entrance or corner, let’s set a start time and note the first few repairs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re definitely still good for around 3:30 with the flashlights and two pairs of gloves, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, 3:30 still works for me after pickup, and I’m bringing the flashlights and two pairs of gloves.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks—just so I’m clear, that’s confirmed on your end, but we’re still waiting on Mara before the rest of the plan is locked in, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Pia, I’d check with Cleo for the current list, but I’ve been telling folks to bring tools and pitch in since the repair drive’s going to need plenty of hands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s what I’m worried about, Vik—can we confirm with Cleo where the drop-off table is and who’s tracking items before more people start bringing things?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, let’s confirm with Cleo first, Pia—I’ve been telling folks to bring tools and help, but we should pin down the drop-off table and who’s tracking items before more people show up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We’re kicking off around 9, Noah, and I’m sorting the donated tools first while Eli and I line up the most urgent homes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, 9, thanks, Sam. I’m still catching up a bit, but that helps a lot—just keep me posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do, Noah—if nothing changes, just meet us there at 9, and I’ll let you know if the order shifts once Eli and I finish the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, right—the repair drive. Can you remind me what Dane said still needs fixing first so I don’t mix up the order again?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but last I heard we still need the exact setup spot confirmed by the community center lot and a clear list of repairs to tackle first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Dane. I’ll make sure we pin down the community center lot spot and get the repair list in order first so I don’t muddle it again.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Uli, I’m still rallying people, but I’m trying to confirm the drop-off times and pickup plan before I spread it any wider—have you heard the latest?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I only know they’re still pulling it together, but Cleo has the current repair list and Opal’s tracking drop-off this afternoon. I can still bring a few tools by when I head over, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That helps a ton—bring them by, and I’ll check with Cleo on the list and Opal on this afternoon’s drop-off before I keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I’ll bring a notepad, gloves, and tape. Just let me know the final house count when you’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina—that helps. I’m still confirming the final house count, and I’ll send it over once Mara and Cleo verify the list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—when do you expect Mara and Cleo to confirm it?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and did they finally settle on a date?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still have it set for Saturday morning at the community center parking lot, Nell, but I want the exact entrance confirmed before we send the final list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps—I’d only heard scraps, so Saturday morning sounds good; do they still need more hands or tools once the entrance’s confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Cleo, I’ve still got the drill and a couple ladders ready for the repair drive—just tell me what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Gus—come by at nine if you can; I’ve still got zip ties and flashlights unclaimed on the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Nine works for me—I’ll bring the drill and ladders, and I can grab the zip ties too if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — once you confirm the exact drop-off spot and send it around, I’ll feel better about helping since at least we know where things go and that you’ve got the intake list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia — it’s Sunday at the community center now, and I’ll send the exact drop-off spot and intake list around today so everyone’s working from the same plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, that helps — once you send the exact spot, I can help without worrying people will show up and not know where to take things.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Leo, so far it’s penciled in for next Saturday at the community center, but I still want Cleo to confirm the exact entrance and Mara to confirm repair coverage before we lock anything in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—once Cleo confirms the entrance and Mara confirms coverage, we’re still short a couple of hammers and some work gloves for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo—that helps; before I ask around for hammers and gloves, I want to make sure Cleo confirms the entrance and Mara confirms who’s covering bike and small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word quick, but can you point me to Cleo for the current repair list while Opal handles the drop-off details this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah—Cleo’s the one with the current repair list, and Opal’s confirming the drop-off spot this afternoon, so I’d send folks to them for those details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—thanks, Rey. I’ll point folks to Cleo for the list and keep spreading the word about Opal’s drop-off details this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ve got it penciled in at the community center parking lot, Gus, but I want the exact entrance and start time confirmed before we send folks over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m planning on getting there early with the drill and both ladders, and as soon as the entrance and start time are confirmed I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Gus — once you confirm the exact entrance and start time, I’ll put together a clear list and let everyone know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and did they finally settle on a date?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not quite yet—I’m still waiting on Mara to confirm the date, but the main jobs sound like the porch steps and the hall roof, and Faye can do 3:30 after pickup if we keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I’d only heard scraps, so that helps; let me know once Mara confirms the date, especially if they still need hands for the smaller fixes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes—zip ties and a couple flashlights are still the ones I’m watching. If you can nudge folks on those, I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’m coming in a bit late, but I’ll ask around about zip ties and a couple flashlights on my way over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks—those are still the main gaps, so let me know what you find and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Tess, I’m glad it’s getting busy—I can swing by around 3:30 after school pickup, and I can bring a wonky lamp if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be perfect, Faye—3:30 should be just fine, and a wonky lamp would fit right in with all the bits and bobs folks are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll come by at 3:30 then, and if you hear they still need gloves or hammers, let me know before school lets out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ve still got the tools set aside, and I’m planning to head over to the community center parking lot this afternoon unless they change the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, perfect—thanks, Uli. I’m still catching up, so if the entrance changes, just text me and I’ll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can do that—I’ll send you a quick text if they confirm a different entrance before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Opal, can you make it by 9, and what can you bring so I can see what’s still uncovered?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can make it by 9, and I’ll bring the location notes and a basic tool kit; I still have the repair drive logged at the community center parking lot, but I want the exact entrance confirmed before we send people over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—9 and a basic kit helps. Can you check with Cleo which entrance we’re using at the community center so we can send people to the right spot?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks, Sam—we’re starting at 9 and doing the urgent fixes first, and I’ll follow your lead so I don’t muddle the order.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You’ve got it, Oren—we’ll meet at 9, start with the urgent house fixes, and I’ll keep the order clear as we go.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good—thanks, Sam. I’ll be there at 9 and stick with the urgent fixes first so I don’t mix things up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: So far it’s penciled in for next Saturday at the community center, and I’m bringing my extra screws and drill. I’m still confirming who can cover bike and small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mara—that sounds promising. I’m still out on errands, so keep me posted once you’ve confirmed who can cover the bike and small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do, Ira—I’ll send you an update as soon as I’ve got those repair spots confirmed for next Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Far as I’ve got it, we’re at the community center next Saturday, and porch steps are the first thing to tackle. Still need to pin down who’s covering the bike and small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s actually bringing tools and whether Leo’s garage is still the storage spot after Saturday? I don’t want us assuming the rest is settled when only Faye’s timing sounds firm.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Only tool note I’ve got for sure is Mara bringing screws and a drill next Saturday, and I haven’t heard anything solid about Leo’s garage still being the storage spot.
